affected_predicate.description: Every bookmarked post is removed from bookmarks, added to favorites, and boosted.

competing_trace_defects.description: After the first bookmark disappears, the trace switches Saved filters and continues bookmark handling without any observable action that favorites or boosts the affected posts.

chains.rationale: At reuse step 11, the agent relied on the false claim that removal had failed and reopened the post menu. The resulting menu visibly said “Bookmark,” showing that the pupper post had already been removed; step 12 then selected that control and restored the bookmark, amplifying the mistaken-state handling. The pupper post later disappears from Bookmarks, visibly correcting that specific harmful state and interrupting the mechanism. Nevertheless, the terminal trace still shows a bookmarked demo post, and no favorite or boost action is observable.

summary: The reused false removal-state history amplified mistaken bookmark handling by causing an already removed post to be re-bookmarked. That specific harm was later visibly corrected, but the complete predicate remained observably unsatisfied because another bookmark remained and no favorite or boost actions were shown.
